tool.name: ANNOVAR (ANNOtate VARiation)

operations.evidence_quote:
table_annovar.pl input.vcf humandb/ \
  --buildver hg19 \
  --outfile annovar_output \
  --remove \
  --protocol refGene,knownGene,dbsnp138 \
  --operation gx,gx,f \
  --thread 4 \
  --otherinfo \
  --nastring .
